web/src/farm/FarmContext.tsx.name: Farm settings holder
web/src/farm/FarmContext.tsx.description: Loads the farm's account details once and makes them available to every signed-in screen.

web/src/farm/useFarm.ts.name: Farm access
web/src/farm/useFarm.ts.description: Gives screens the farm's settings and today's date in the farm's own timezone.

web/src/farm/useFormat.ts.name: Farm formatting
web/src/farm/useFormat.ts.description: Formats money, counts, dates and numbers the way the farm's region expects.

web/src/farm/useLogoObjectUrl.ts.name: Farm logo and banner
web/src/farm/useLogoObjectUrl.ts.description: Fetches the farm's logo and banner images so they can be displayed.

web/src/lib/accountStorage.ts.name: Per-account browser memory
web/src/lib/accountStorage.ts.description: Saves small preferences in the browser separately for each account and clears leftovers.

web/src/lib/bannerCache.ts.name: Banner cache
web/src/lib/bannerCache.ts.description: Keeps the farm's banner image in the browser so it need not be downloaded every time, and drops it if another account signs in.

web/src/lib/brand.ts.name: Colour brands
web/src/lib/brand.ts.description: The list of colour brand choices, with Aubergine as the default.

web/src/lib/breakpoints.ts.name: Phone or desktop check
web/src/lib/breakpoints.ts.description: Tells screens whether to show the phone or desktop layout.

web/src/lib/dashboard.ts.name: Dashboard numbers
web/src/lib/dashboard.ts.description: Works out the Dashboard's tiles, such as flocks with no entry today, and splits lists into pages.

web/src/lib/dates.ts.name: Date helpers
web/src/lib/dates.ts.description: Works out today's date and past dates on the farm's calendar and checks timezone names.

web/src/lib/dayWindow.ts.name: Day window sizing
web/src/lib/dayWindow.ts.description: Decides how big each day box is and whether a date range fits or must scroll.

web/src/lib/discountCeiling.ts.name: Discount limit
web/src/lib/discountCeiling.ts.description: Works out the biggest discount a person may give, based on the farm's limit and their role.

web/src/lib/errText.ts.name: Error text
web/src/lib/errText.ts.description: Turns a failure into a message that can be shown.

web/src/lib/flockDefault.ts.name: Default flock
web/src/lib/flockDefault.ts.description: Remembers the last flock used and picks the starting flock on entry screens.

web/src/lib/format.ts.name: Number and money formatting
web/src/lib/format.ts.description: Formats money in the right currency decimals, plus egg counts and other numbers.

web/src/lib/grading.ts.name: Grading status
web/src/lib/grading.ts.description: Compares graded eggs to the total counted and says if it is still counting, matches, or is over.

web/src/lib/ids.ts.name: Unique IDs
web/src/lib/ids.ts.description: Makes unique codes that stop a repeated click from saving twice.

web/src/lib/languageHint.ts.name: Language memory
web/src/lib/languageHint.ts.description: Remembers the chosen language and picks the starting language.

web/src/lib/layRateRange.ts.name: Lay-rate date ranges
web/src/lib/layRateRange.ts.description: The preset date ranges offered for the lay-rate chart and its expanded view.

web/src/lib/mainContent.ts.name: Main content marker
web/src/lib/mainContent.ts.description: Names the main page area so the skip link and focus can find it.

web/src/lib/productionReportSplit.ts.name: Production report splitter
web/src/lib/productionReportSplit.ts.description: Splits one production report into this week, last week and the morning collection so the Dashboard makes one request.

web/src/lib/relativeTime.ts.name: Time ago
web/src/lib/relativeTime.ts.description: Turns a moment into wording like '3 days ago' using the farm's calendar.

web/src/lib/saveBlob.ts.name: File saver
web/src/lib/saveBlob.ts.description: Saves a downloaded file to the person's device.

web/src/lib/secondFactorMessage.ts.name: Security code messages
web/src/lib/secondFactorMessage.ts.description: The shared wording for security code answers at sign-in and confirmation.

web/src/lib/stepperUnit.ts.name: Entry step size
web/src/lib/stepperUnit.ts.description: Decides how much the plus and minus buttons count by: the person's choice, else the farm's default.

web/src/lib/theme.ts.name: Light and night mode
web/src/lib/theme.ts.description: Picks light or night mode, follows the device setting, and applies it.

web/src/lib/traceparent.ts.name: Request tracing ID
web/src/lib/traceparent.ts.description: Makes an identifier attached to each request to help trace problems.

web/src/styles.css.name: Stylesheet index
web/src/styles.css.description: Pulls all the style files together into one stylesheet.

web/src/styles/audit.css.name: Audit styles
web/src/styles/audit.css.description: Looks for the audit history screen.

web/src/styles/base.css.name: Base styles
web/src/styles/base.css.description: Page-wide basics such as background and text.

web/src/styles/controls.css.name: Control styles
web/src/styles/controls.css.description: Looks for buttons, fields and other controls.

web/src/styles/daily-entry.css.name: Daily entry styles
web/src/styles/daily-entry.css.description: Looks for the daily egg entry screen.

web/src/styles/day-strip.css.name: Day strip styles
web/src/styles/day-strip.css.description: Looks for the day strip and its fill patterns.

web/src/styles/expanded-lay-rate.css.name: Expanded chart styles
web/src/styles/expanded-lay-rate.css.description: Looks for the expanded lay-rate chart.

web/src/styles/responsive.css.name: Responsive styles
web/src/styles/responsive.css.description: Adjusts layouts for phone and desktop sizes.
